name: Schelling's tipping: Fig. 18 with Blue moving faster
description: Fig. 18 (100 Red, 50 Blue, tolerances from 2.0) from 25 of each, with Blue making up to five moves a step to Red's one. Schelling: which one-color equilibrium occurs "depends on how the process starts and, perhaps, the relative speeds". Measured (exact schedules; recorded 2026-09-29): Red ends alone at every speed: here the numbers decide, not the speed.
